items.title: Lighter on your TV
items.text: ORIGIN hands memory back to the TV at once: when a film starts, when you leave it, and when you press Home.

items.title: Plug in a drive, that is all
items.text: A new USB drive is checked in seconds and torrents buffer on it by themselves. An SSD works best.

items.title: Your subtitle languages, every time
items.text: Found whatever way an addon names the language. Your second language steps in when the first has none.
